verdicts.decision_note: The source establishes the expected mobile-wallet behavior: opening the gated book must initiate the ownership-signature request needed to load it.
First concrete failure: Rainbow Wallet connected on mobile, but opening the book produced no required signing request.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer reports resolving the contextualized Lit-related book-access issue before the subsequent mobile retest.
Post-fix persistence on a distinct mobile-wallet path: desktop access worked, but book access still failed through the MetaMask mobile wallet.
